Product Description

These are running shoes anyone can wear to go faster—with Charged Cushioning® to help protect against impact, a breathable upper, and durability for miles.
  • Ventilated
Product Details
  • Lightweight, breathable mesh upper with leather overlays for added durability & support
  • Deluxe Comfort System sockliner molds to your foot for ultimate step-in comfort
  • Charged Cushioning® midsole provides ultimate responsiveness & durability
  • Solid rubber outsole covers high impact zones for greater durability with less weight
  • Upper contains at least 20% recycled content
